Name: Tobiah the Ammonite
Summary: Ammonite servant-official who joined Sanballat against the wall, later occupied a temple chamber through Eliashib, and was expelled by Nehemiah.
KeyVerses: Nehemiah 2:10; Nehemiah 2:19; Nehemiah 4:3; Nehemiah 4:7; Nehemiah 6:1; Nehemiah 6:12; Nehemiah 6:14; Nehemiah 6:17; Nehemiah 6:19; Nehemiah 13:4; Nehemiah 13:7; Nehemiah 13:8
LifeLesson: An enemy inside the house is more dangerous than one outside the wall.
